content:
q07.

`web/src/connect.ts`

That single module builds the `createConnectTransport` (web/src/connect.ts:184) plus an auth-refresh transport (web/src/connect.ts:65), then exports every service client from it — `instanceServiceClient`, `authServiceClient`, `userServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, `attachmentServiceClient`, `aiServiceClient`, `shortcutServiceClient`, `identityProviderServiceClient` (web/src/connect.ts:192–203).
